1. Purpose and Scope
This procedure covers planned replacement of a drive-end or non-drive-end deep groove ball bearing on
medium-to-large industrial electric motors where an outer race fault has been confirmed at ISO 13373-1 Stage 3 or
above. Stage 3 is defined as BPFO band energy exceeding 3.5× the established healthy baseline AND kurtosis
exceeding 5.0. At Stage 3, bearing replacement is mandatory — lubrication or re-greasing will NOT

g 3.5× the established healthy baseline AND kurtosis
exceeding 5.0. At Stage 3, bearing replacement is mandatory — lubrication or re-greasing will NOT arrest
